newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss National Bank leaves discount rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Swiss National Bank leaves discount rate unchanged.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said it was leaving its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after a regular weekly meeting of its three-member board.
"No change," said an SNB spokesman in response to an enquiry.

The rate at current levels matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979. The rate was last changed when it was lowered from 1.50 percent on September 26, 1996. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
